amap-maps-streamableHTTP 0.1.1

- No file changes detected in this version.
- Functionality, documentation, and dependencies remain unchanged.

Initial release of amap-maps-streamableHTTP.

- Provides unified access to Amap mapping and location tools via OneKey Gateway.
- Supports a variety of map functions including routing (driving, bicycling, walking, public transit), geocoding, reverse geocoding, distance calculation, POI search, weather retrieval, and more.
- Offers easy CLI usage examples and tool-specific scripts for all major Amap map APIs.
- Includes instructions for setup, API key configuration, and Python/npm dependency installation.
- Automatic demo key fallback for easier getting started.
